[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-zs[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Harden every GitHub network interaction against slow and degraded [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]transports[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A slow, congested, or degraded GitHub transport degrades SASE [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]gracefully instead of failing an agent run: redundant bulk [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]transfers are eliminated, every network git and `gh` call retries [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]transient failures under a shared deterministic classifier, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]wall-clock timeouts are replaced by stall-aware deadlines, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]sustained degradation is visible in telemetry before it becomes an [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]agent failure.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202609/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]github_network_resilience.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202609/github_network_resilience.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-zs[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-zs/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Borrow local objects when materializing sidecar SDD clones[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]ref-reuse[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]ref-reuse: pass a validated `reference_repo` down the sidecar-kind clone[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]path so workspace materialization of the plans store stops [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]re-downloading the full pack from GitHub on every launch.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Make remote clone timeouts retryable instead of fatal[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]clone-retry[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]clone-retry: close the hole where `SddGitCommandTimeout` bypasses the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]clone retry loop whenever no reference repo is in play, and give retries[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]an escalating, deadline-aware timeout budget.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Deterministic retryability classifier in the Rust core[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]classifier[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]classifier: port transient-failure detection for git and `gh` output [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]into sase_core as a pure deterministic classifier with a PyO3 binding, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]replacing the ad-hoc substring tuple that only covers git clone stderr.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Replace fixed wall-clock timeouts with stall-aware deadlines[/bold #D7AFFF]  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]stall-deadline[dim] · [dim][/dim]after clone-retry[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]stall-deadline: stream git progress output so a slow-but-advancing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]transfer is distinguished from a genuinely stalled one, bounding idle [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]time rather than total duration.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Single retrying chokepoint for gh CLI calls[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]gh-runner[dim] · [dim][/dim]after classifier[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gh-runner: add one bounded, non-interactive `gh` execution boundary that[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]applies the shared classifier, honors rate-limit and Retry-After [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]signals, and reports structured failures.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Migrate ad-hoc GitHub call sites onto the shared runners[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]adoption[dim] · [dim][/dim]after classifier, gh-runner[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]adoption: move the scattered direct `gh` subprocess calls and the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]remaining network git paths in agents sync and bead sync onto the shared[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]retrying runners so resilience is uniform rather than per-call-site.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bound clone concurrency and stop stranding workspaces on [/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]transient failure[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]materialization[dim] · [dim][/dim]after clone-retry[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]materialization: cap concurrent remote clones so parallel launches stop [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]saturating the uplink, and let the agent runner degrade or requeue [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]instead of hard-failing and holding a numbered workspace.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Surface transport degradation before it fails a run[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]observability[dim] · [dim][/dim]after classifier, stall-deadline[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]observability: record near-miss margin and retry outcomes on network git[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]operations and add a doctor check that warns when durations trend toward[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the configured ceiling.[/#D7D7AF]
